problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting cargo containers to load onto a transport vehicle. The available containers are:
* Container A: occupies 17 cubic meters, revenue $41
* Container B: occupies 36 cubic meters, revenue $17
* Container C: occupies 6 cubic meters, revenue $214
* Container D: occupies 46 cubic meters, revenue $10
* Container E: occupies 40 cubic meters, revenue $262
The vehicle has a maximum capacity of 101 cubic meters. Choose the combination of containers that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
